snippet.title: Grail - Demo out now!
snippet.description:
In this deckbuilder your deck fights for you. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?

Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4537510
